description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional categories in a dataset used for evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech, with each segment representing a distinct emotion and its corresponding proportion of the total. The chart is divided into six labeled slices, each with a distinct color and percentage value displayed within or near the segment. The largest segment, colored light blue, represents "Frustration" and accounts for 25.1% of the total. The second largest, in dark blue, is "Neutral" at 23.1%. "Happiness" is shown in light blue and makes up 14.1%, while "Excitement," in orange, represents 14.7%. "Sadness," also in orange, accounts for 14.7%, and "Anger," in yellow, is the smallest segment at 14.9%. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top, with no visual emphasis such as an exploded slice. The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice, allowing for direct comparison of the relative frequency of each emotion in the dataset.
